env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd badedition
! logos build .
stderr 'logos\.toml:2:1: unknown key "edition"'
cd ..

cd emptyname
! logos build .
stderr 'logos\.toml:2:1: unknown key "name"'
cd ..

cd strict
! logos build .
stderr '\[correctness::extension_not_enabled\] x\.⚡: extension \.⚡ is not enabled by logos\.toml strict_files'

rm logos.toml
logos build .
logos run .
stdout '^zap$'
cd ..

-- badedition/go.mod --
module badedition

go 1.27

-- badedition/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- badedition/logos.toml --
[project]
edition = "2027"

-- emptyname/go.mod --
module emptyname

go 1.27

-- emptyname/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- emptyname/logos.toml --
[project]
name = ""

-- strict/go.mod --
module strict

go 1.27

-- strict/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println(Zap()) }

-- strict/x.⚡ --
package main

func Zap() string { return "zap" }

-- strict/logos.toml --
[project]
strict_files = [".lgo"]
